headline: Prepare for El Niño, whatever storms it may or may not bring.
summary: By now you’ve probably heard about the “Super El Niño” that is predicted to come our way over the winter. It’s got me, Pam Marino, mulling over how prepared I am should the power go out. I’m starting a list
